title: Leadline Evidence Route Contract
description: The ordered, auditable plan Leadline emits per turn: obligations only. Execution results live in use-receipt.schema.json. A step is satisfied only when its machine-readable satisfaction criteria are met — never by mere invocation.

contract_id.description: Stable id for this contract instance.

policy_version.description: Version/hash of the tells+routes policy that produced this.

steps.description: Evidence obligations. May be empty when abstained=true.

need.description: The epistemic evidence family this obligation requires.

provider.description: Adapter-resolved tool for this need (e.g. gbrain, graphify, grep, cli-probe).

availability.description: Hard feasibility from the arbiter; orthogonal to classification confidence.

evidence_target.description: What the evidence must be ABOUT — the anchor a receipt is checked against.

question.description: Normalized obligation, e.g. 'direct callers of performSync'.

satisfaction.description: Machine-readable criteria a receipt must meet. Makes gate-gaming detectable.

requires_relevance_to.description: Tokens/ids the result must reference to count. Empty targets are invalid and must abstain.

source_scope.description: Optional corpus/scope the provider should target (renamed from ambiguous 'source').

semantic_diagnostics.description: Open-set semantic score and gate diagnostics. Present only for embedding-classified steps.

ordered_route.description: step_id references in execution order. The single source of ordering — steps carry no order themselves.

complete.description: True only when every positive clause produced a target-resolved evidence obligation.

unmatched_clauses.description: Positive clauses that could not become an evidence obligation. Non-empty means the plan is partial and complete=false.

first_action.description: Derived convenience: provider of the first ordered step. Never authored independently.
